title: Great value, excellent product brands
text: So excited to try my first Tribe beauty box, and it did not disappoint!!!  Everything in this box I can use.  I received a Bebella Beauty Lotus love palette- a new brand for me which blended beautifully !  A mani/ Pedi treatment set from Spongelle, a brand I love!  Wander Beauty's Frame your face brow gel, An eyeshadow stick from The Balm, and the Prestige Invigorating  & Resurfacing Eye Contour from Symbiosis London.  Was stoked to get the Eye Contour because I had been looking for a retinol product for my eye are.  Definitely a great value for the money- no way could I have bought all those things separately for the price of this box.  Everything was packaged nicely.
label: positive
